character: Musashi (2026-10-07, the owner's canon): an elf, once of the Fortunate Five with Phi and Grim, a friend of Orik's. He loved cooking and lost his sense of taste to a curse from the Hollows; now he keeps the Kariaston market cart, selling ingredients so others can make what he can't taste. His brother Toshi is missing in the Hollows. Black hair parted under a cook's white bandana (the ponytail hid his elf ears), a white vest, a kind smile with something wistful in the brows.
